name: Fernando Belaúnde
contribution: A Peruvian politician who twice served as President of Peru.
legacy: This person held a doctrine called "The Conquest of Peru by Peruvians", which promoted the exploitation of resources in the Amazon rainforest and other outlying areas of Peru through conquest, stating "only by turning our vision to the interior, and conquering our wilderness as the United States once did, will South America finally achieve true development".

checks.lead: Fernando Sergio Marcelo Marcos Belaúnde Terry (7 October 1912 – 4 June 2002) was a Peruvian politician who twice served as President of Peru (1963–1968 and 1980–1985). Deposed by a military coup in 1968, he was re-elected in 1980 after twelve years of military rule.
